lines.text: Van Persie headed in against his old club. Six years later to the day, Salah headed in against City.
10 November 2013: Van Persie headed the only goal at Old Trafford. United beat Arsenal, his old club, one nil.
10 November 2019: Salah headed Liverpool's second from a Robertson cross. Liverpool beat City three one.
In 2013 United were the champions and Arsenal were top. In 2019 City were champions and Liverpool top.
That night Arsenal were still top. United finished the season seventh.
Liverpool went nine points clear of City and won the league, their first title in 30 years.
Van Persie or Salah: whose Premier League peak was higher?
